channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Knicks Sign Former Lakers First-Round Pick Dalton Knecht to Two-Way Deal
item.description: The New York Knicks have signed forward Dalton Knecht to a two-way contract after the Los Angeles Lakers waived him last week.

item.title: Singapore targets 10 firms in first use of Transboundary Haze Pollution Act
item.description: The National Environment Agency issued notices to 10 Singapore-based firms for the first time to investigate their connection to regional haze.

item.title: Tampa Bay Rays surge to early lead in World Series Game One
item.description: The Tampa Bay Rays have established a 2-0 lead against the Milwaukee Brewers in the opening game of the 2026 World Series.

item.title: Herro's homecoming debut fuels Bucks against injury-hit Bulls in Milwaukee
item.description: Tyler Herro makes his home debut for the Milwaukee Bucks against the Chicago Bulls on Wednesday at 4:10 p.m. ET after scoring 24 points in Milwaukee's 128-116 loss to Washington, while the Bulls arrive fresh off a 135-92 rout by Toronto.

item.title: Miranda Hart opens up about ME diagnosis that forced her off stage
item.description: Celebrity Traitors star Miranda Hart revealed she was diagnosed with ME (chronic fatigue syndrome) in 2024, which prevented her from enjoying her career and left her fearing she would never walk again.

item.title: One goal away: Pirates seek CAF group stage berth against African Stars
item.description: Orlando Pirates hold a 1-0 advantage from the first leg and need to avoid defeat Friday at Orlando Amstel Arena to reach the CAF Champions League group stage for the first time since last season's failure.

item.title: Wind wreaks havoc at Portman Road as Ipswich host struggling Forest
item.description: Ipswich Town face Nottingham Forest in a Premier League match at Portman Road where strong wind conditions are affecting play, with Forest having failed to score in four top-flight games this season.

item.title: Kaizer Chiefs Chase One-Goal Deficit Against Red Arrows For Group Stage
item.description: Kaizer Chiefs host Red Arrows in the CAF Confederation Cup second-leg tie on Friday to overturn a 1-0 first-leg deficit.

item.title: Winnipeg Jets actively negotiate Connor Hellebuyck trade to New Jersey Devils
item.description: The Winnipeg Jets are currently working to finalize a trade sending three-time Vezina Trophy winner Connor Hellebuyck to the New Jersey Devils.

item.title: Al-Nassr Sticks With Starting XI to Topple Al-Faisaly in Friday Showdown
item.description: Al-Nassr manager Ange Postecoglou retains his lineup for Friday's eleventh round Saudi Roshn League clash against Al-Faisaly.

item.title: Storm Austen Slams Ireland With Heavy Rain And Severe Flooding Warnings
item.description: Ireland is under a nationwide yellow weather warning until 10am following the arrival of the year's first major storm.

item.title: Connor McDavid reaches 30 points in 10 games, fourth player in history
item.description: Edmonton Oilers captain Connor McDavid secured his 30th point of the season during a match against the Carolina Hurricanes to join an elite NHL record group.

item.title: Celtic collapse in Europe as Javi Rodriguez double stuns home side
item.description: Celtic suffered their third consecutive Europa League defeat after falling 2-1 to Celta Vigo at Celtic Park.

item.title: Jablonec stalemate snaps Brighton’s six-game winning streak in UEFA Conference League clash
item.description: Brighton failed to score for the first time in 10 matches after a goalless draw against Jablonec in the UEFA Conference League.

item.title: Bournemouth Rout Seven-Time European Champions Milan In Historic 3-0 Europa League Victory
item.description: Bournemouth secured a 3-0 win against 10-man AC Milan in the Europa League after Mike Maignan was sent off for a first-half confrontation.

item.title: Cancer, Pisces, and Scorpio finally break free from hard times Friday
item.description: The Moon conjuncts Neptune on October 23, 2026, marking the end of struggles for three specific signs.

item.title: Global scramble as critical PHP flaw forces millions of sites offline
item.description: Governments and businesses took services offline after a critical PHP flaw threatened to expose 70% of the world's websites to potential hacks.

item.title: Bournemouth doubles lead against 10-man Milan in Europa League clash
item.description: Bournemouth built a two-goal advantage over AC Milan in their Europa League match after Milan were reduced to 10 men, according to BBC live coverage.

item.title: Financial Heavyweight Celtic Faces Impoverished Celta Vigo in Europa League Clash
item.description: Celtic faces Celta Vigo tonight in the Europa League while currently holding zero points from two matches this season.

item.title: Emery emerges as leading target for Manchester United after 4-1 Como humiliation
item.description: Unai Emery and Julian Nagelsmann have been identified as top candidates to replace Michael Carrick at Manchester United following the club's worst start to a season since 1986.

item.title: UK launches 'Be Ready' campaign urging households to stock three-day emergency supplies
item.description: The UK government has started a national resilience conversation warning the public to prepare for cyber attacks, natural disasters, and supply chain disruptions by stockpiling food, water, and first aid supplies.

item.title: Nasdaq tumbles 2.2% as AI stocks crumble on interest rate fears
item.description: The Nasdaq composite fell 2.2% on Thursday as artificial intelligence stocks dragged markets down worldwide, with oil prices climbing to their highest since May amid Iran war concerns.

item.title: State Department warns Americans face serious risk of wrongful detention in China
item.description: The U.S. State Department updated its travel advisory for mainland China on October 19, adding a wrongful detention warning and cautioning that Americans could be detained for years without fair legal process or allowed to leave the country.

item.title: Luka Dončić Routs Warriors 127-105 In Los Angeles Lakers Season Opener
item.description: The Los Angeles Lakers secured a season-opening victory over the Golden State Warriors behind 28 points from Luka Dončić on Wednesday.

item.title: South Africa levels series with innings-and-31-run demolition of Australia at Gqeberha
item.description: South Africa defeated Australia by an innings and 31 runs in the second Test at St George's Park on Thursday to tie the three-Test series at 1-1, setting up a series decider in Cape Town.

item.title: Alexandra Eala Routs Diane Parry to Reach Ningbo Round of 16
item.description: Alexandra Eala secured her 34th tour-level victory of 2026 by defeating Diane Parry 6-3, 6-1 in the first round of the WTA 500 event in Ningbo.

item.title: England battles Sri Lanka in Rawalpindi after failing to chase 300 runs
item.description: England plays Sri Lanka in a pivotal one-day international tri-series match in Rawalpindi following a recent defeat against Pakistan.

item.title: Storm Austen floods Ireland: orange warnings for six counties tonight and Friday
item.description: Storm Austen brings intense rain and flooding to Ireland from Thursday evening, with orange warnings in place for Cork, Kerry, Waterford, Dublin, Wexford, and Wicklow through Friday morning.

item.title: India Favored to Clinch Opening T20I Victory Over New Zealand at Christchurch
item.description: India faces New Zealand in the first of five T20Is on October 22 at Hagley Oval starting at 8:00 p.m. NZDT.

item.title: Divers Finally Locate German U-672 Submarine Lost for 82 Years Off Devon
item.description: The U-672 submarine, which was scuttled by its crew in 1944, has been identified 20 miles off the coast of Salcombe.

item.title: 81st-minute Vitinha strike and Ruiz's late finish sink unbeaten Barcelona 4-2
item.description: PSG defeated previously-unbeaten Barcelona 4-2 at home on Tuesday with two late goals, extending the defending Champions League champion's winning streak to three matches.

item.title: 18-year-old Ngumoha inspires Liverpool to thrilling 4-3 Champions League comeback victory
item.description: Liverpool secured their third consecutive Champions League league phase win after overcoming an initial two-goal deficit against Villarreal at Anfield.

item.title: Manchester United hunt first win in six as Como test looms in Champions League
item.description: Manchester United visit Como on Wednesday aiming to end a six-game winless run in the Champions League after drawing 1–1 at Leeds.

item.title: EA shuts down BioWare, cancels next Mass Effect game in 3% workforce cut
item.description: Electronic Arts is closing BioWare studio and cutting approximately 400 jobs, equal to 3% of its workforce, months after going private through an $55 billion leveraged buyout.

item.title: Osimhen returns to France as Lille and Galatasaray draw 1-1 in UCL
item.description: Victor Osimhen and Galatasaray drew 1-1 with Lille in the Champions League on Wednesday, with both sides seeking their first points after opening losses.

item.title: Nico Paz scores in under 2 minutes as Como stuns Manchester United in Champions debut
item.description: Argentine winger Nico Paz scored a spectacular goal in under two minutes as Como shocked Manchester United 1-0 in Champions League matchday three on October 21, marking the Italian club's historic first European competition appearance.

item.title: OCBC becomes first non-Malaysian bank to offer ringgit savings with 1% interest from Oct 23
item.description: OCBC customers can now hold up to RM50,000 in Malaysian ringgit in Singapore-based savings accounts starting October 23, earning 1 percent annual interest until June 30 next year.

item.title: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander Leads Thunder Past Spurs in Statement 116-104 Season Opening Win
item.description: The Oklahoma City Thunder defeated the San Antonio Spurs 116-104 on October 20, 2026, as Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 32 points.

item.title: Actor Thomas Ong downsizes to 38 sq m HDB flat for efficiency
item.description: Local actor Thomas Ong moved from a three-room flat to a two-room Flexi unit near Canberra MRT to eliminate redundant space.

item.title: Kenya's milk farmers gain 8% pay raise to Ksh65 per litre starting October
item.description: President William Ruto announced dairy farmers will earn Ksh65 per litre of milk from October 2026, up from Ksh60, plus a quarterly Ksh2 bonus, as the country battles persistent milk shortages.
